$comment: Pinned third-party plugin sources. Every entry is copied into vendor/<dest> by scripts/vendor.py.
ref MUST be a full 40-char commit SHA, never a branch name. A branch means the content can
change under you between two syncs without anyone reviewing the diff.
To bump: run `python3 scripts/vendor.py --check` to see what moved upstream, then edit `ref`
here, run `python3 scripts/vendor.py`, and open a PR. The PR diff IS the review.
Only plugins with no Anthropic-listed equivalent belong here. Anything on the official
marketplace is already CI-pinned by Anthropic and is enabled via enabledPlugins instead -

sources.notes: Plugin root is the repo root; manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills under .claude/skills/. Pinned to v2.11.0 - the build already in production use. Upstream is at v2.13.0 (c87cdc22); the weekly bot will open that as a reviewable PR.
